[[Sunnyglade Valley]] | gender = Male }} '''Alurzion''' is a [[Sunnyglade Valley]] battlemaster located in the [[Caverns of Time]] in [[Tanaris]]. Within Sunnyglade, he can be found at [[Fort Vallance]] in the center of the map, where players can turn in [[Flickering Time Spark]]s while their faction controls the castle. ==Notes and trivia== * Though he is a bronze dragon, he is classified as a humanoid. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.16.0|note=Added.}} [[Category:Bronze dragons]] [[Category:Caverns of Time NPCs]] [[Category:Sunnyglade Valley NPCs]] [[Category:Battlemasters]] [[Category:Oddly classified characters]]
